title: ADR-0012 §6.1: the hosted push relay picks the generic notice line in the recipient's language, not "the device locale" (follow-up to #29920 Q4 C)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ③ a maintainer ruling that names this card: #29920 Q4 C (Ruling confirmed on the card, maintainer 「…其他同意」 2026-11-05T21:37Z), item 6 — "ADR-0012 §6.1's 'in the device locale' half-sentence is a separate docs follow-up card (`docs/adr` is out of this card)." ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3.
Dedupe: `ADR-0012 device locale push relay`. Nearest: #29920 (the server half). **New.**

## What is wrong

ADR-0012 §6.1 says the hosted relay's generic notice line is chosen "in the device locale". The ruling and the #29920 PR choose it by `resolveRecipientLocale` (`sys_user.locale` → deployment default), English when absent; `push-relay.zod.ts`'s `describe` says "in the recipient's language".

## Expected

One half-sentence in ADR-0012 §6.1 reworded to "in the recipient's language (`sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default)", with the ADR's amendment line and its `scripts/adr-anchors/` anchor per the ADR conventions. `docs/adr` is Tier H: reviewers per the routing rule, the maintainer merges.

Reader: whoever carries ADR amendments (Tier H). Serial: after #29920's PR merges.
